The First Turn-On! | The First Turn-On!  is a 1983 comedy film directed by Lloyd Kaufman and Michael Herz of Troma Entertainment.  It was the last in a series of four "sexy comedies" that helped establish Troma as a film studio, starting with 1979's "Squeeze Play! ", 1981's "Waitress! " and 1982's "Stuck on You! ".
Jezebel (Chely Wright song) | "Jezebel" is a song recorded by American country music artist Chely Wright.  It was released in December 2001 as the second single from the album "Never Love You Enough".  The song reached number 23 on the "Billboard" Hot Country Singles & Tracks chart.  Jay DeMarcus, of Rascal Flatts and formerly of Wright's road band, co-wrote the song with Marcus Hummon.
